body.name: Two-donor switch experiment
body.construction: Observe the explicitly two-dimensional score vector \(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}\). Under state \(\ell=0\), \(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}\sim N((0,c)^{\top},I_2)\) and the ATT is \(0\); under state \(\ell=1\), \(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}\sim N((c,0)^{\top},I_2)\) and the ATT is \(\Delta\). The maps \(L_{\mathrm{sw}}\) and \(L_{\perp}\) embed the experiment in \(Z^{\mathrm{pan}}\) when \(J=2\), \(q=1\), \(b=(0,\Delta)^{\top}\), \(L_{\mathrm{sw}}\Omega L_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\top}=I_2\), and \(U^{\mathrm{sw}}\) is independent of \(Z^{\mathrm{sw}}\) with a state-invariant law.
